newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Namibian stocks week - Diamond shares sparkle.
newsitem.headline: Namibian stocks week - Diamond shares sparkle.

text.p: The lure of diamonds on Namibia's seabed was a highlight of trade last week as shares in Ocean Diamond Mining (ODM) continued to climb.
The Local Index improved to end up at 151.71 from a previous 150.07 but the Overall Index was off at 212.46 against 218.70.
ODM traded on Friday at N$5.70 after starting the week at N$5.40. Strong buying interest was also seen in Namibia Breweries which lifted to N$2.60 from N$2.50.
The biggest value of shares traded was in First National Bank Holdings, parent of the Namibian bank, with N$1.8 million worth of stock traded.
The total value of shares dealt last week was N$5.1 million.
